about: DND-1902: what a GitHub repo's base tip must not CONTAIN for a merge onto it (ai/lib/gh-merge-guard.sh -> gmg_content_health). Keyed by lower-case <owner>/<repo>. unique_migration_dirs is an ERE matched against each directory path in the tip's tree; in every matching directory, no two files named <digits>_*.exs may share the digits (an Ecto migration version). A repo not listed declares no content check. The bar lives here, in custom, never in the repo whose merge it judges.
